items.title: 3.8 Applying Concepts of Integration to Real-Life World Problems (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Book p. 115: heading 3.8 only; the printed text starts at 3.8.1 (sub-topics 3.8.1-3.8.4 on p. 115-121).

blocks.text: Ab tak humne integration ko zyada tar ek "formula chalane" wale kaam ki tarah dekha. Is hisse (3.8) mein hum dekhenge ke yahi integration asal zindagi ke masail (real-life problems) kaise hal karti hai: ghoomti hui cheezon ki moment of inertia, chalti hui gaari ka faasla (distance), kisi function ki average value, aur dawai (drug) ki sahi miqdaar (dose).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Kitab 3.8 ka heading de kar seedha 3.8.1 par chali jati hai; is heading ke neeche kitab ka apna koi text nahin hai. Yeh note hamari taraf se hai, taa ke aap ko pehle se pata ho ke chaaron sub-topics aapas mein kaise jude hain.
Poore 3.8 mein ek hi idea baar baar aata hai: jab koi cheez bohat saare chhote chhote tukron (pieces) se bani ho, to pehle ek chhote tukre ka hissa (contribution) likhte hain, phir definite integral se saare tukre jama (add) kar dete hain. Jaise ek dukandaar din bhar ki chhoti chhoti sales jama kar ke total kamai nikalta hai, waise hi integral chhote hisson ko jama kar ke poora jawab deta hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Shuru karne se pehle yeh cheezein zehan mein taaza kar lijiye: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus \(\int_a^b f'(x)\,dx = f(b) - f(a)\) (yani kisi rate ka integral kul tabdeeli deta hai), power rule \(\int x^{n}\,dx = \frac{x^{n+1}}{n+1} + c\), aur \(\int e^{kx}\,dx = \frac{e^{kx}}{k} + c\). 3.8 ki har misaal sirf inhi teen cheezon se hal ho jati hai, is liye ghabraiye mat: naya sirf yeh hai ke sawal ko integral ki shakal mein kaise likhna hai.
Khud sochiye: agar ek gaari ki speed har second badal rahi ho to kul faasla sirf "speed \(\times\) time" se kyun nahin nikal sakta? Jawab 3.8.2 mein milega.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Integration bohat saare chhote hisson ko jama karti hai; isi liye physics, motion, average aur medicine sab mein kaam aati hai.
2. Pehle ek chhote tukre ka hissa likhiye, phir aisi limits chuniye jo poori cheez ya poore waqt ko cover karein.
3. Units saath rakhiye: jawab ki unit = (integrand ki unit) \(\times\) (variable ki unit).

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Limits bhool jana ya ghalat limits lagana: limits bilkul utni honi chahiyein jitni cheez ya waqt sawal mein diya gaya hai.
2. Real-life sawalon mein units chhor dena (kg m\(^2\), m, log, mg h/L). Jawab bina unit ke adhoora hai.
